snippet.title: Rogue Planet Demo + Steam Announcement (Page Up Soon!)
snippet.description:
Rogue Planet has been a passion project for me for well over a couple of years, and I am finally initiating its publication. The game features a unique and original story by me, Brielle Thames. The steam page doesn't have an official release, just when I am able to find the funds. Likely within the next month. Notice will be given!

I hope my hard work shows you just how passionate I am about this RPG.

Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/brielle_artz/

Don't forget to wishlist when the demo and page releases!
